extraction.extraction_notes: COMPANY NAME: The deck uses both 'Canna Farm' (slide 5) and 'CannaFarm' (slide 7); I used 'CannaFarm' as the more formal reference. The title slide says only 'Cannabis Investor Pitch Deck' with no company name. NO TICKER OR CIK stated — company appears to be a pre-revenue private startup seeking seed/early-stage investment. WEBSITE: Contact slide shows 'cannabusinessplan.com' and email 'info@cannabusiness.com' — note the domain mismatch between the two. REVENUE FIGURES: All revenue projections (Year 1–3) are forward-looking and use approximate language ('about'). The chart on slide 13 shows Net Income and Gross Profit for Years 1–5 but exact values are only readable from the chart axis (approximate) and not stated textually beyond deal size ranges. The chart y-axis on slide 14 is labeled '$US K' implying thousands; Year 1 ≈ $3K in chart but text says $200K — there may be an inconsistency between chart scale and textual annotation. MARKET DATA: The $22.8B by 2029 figure and 28% CAGR are attributed to unspecified 'expert projections' with no source cited. The licensed business counts are dated Aug 1, 2025 but do not specify which state (context implies California). REGULATORY: No specific license status, pending filings, or compliance claims are made. The SWOT slide (8) mentions 'Product liability/legal issues' and 'Enhanced risk of banking/financial/IRS scrutiny' as weaknesses but does not state any current compliance posture. TEAM: Only names and titles provided — no background, credentials, or prior experience stated. TRACTION: No current customer counts, retention metrics, LTV/CAC, or historical revenue are stated. FISCAL YEAR END: Not stated or implied.
